help.root:
manax - Clash Meta kernel control tool

Usage: manax <command> [args]

Status
   status                         Show Manax status
   reload                         Reload current config
   stop                           Stop kernel and proxy

Control
   mode <direct|rule|global>      Set running mode
   system <on|off>                Toggle system proxy
   tun <on|off>                   Toggle TUN

Config
   conf add <name> <url-or-file>  Import a subscription or config
   conf list                      List configs
   conf use <name>                Load a config
   conf update [name]             Update a config
   conf rm <name>                 Delete a config

Nodes
   node list                      List nodes
   node test                      Test all nodes
   node use <node>                Select a node by its index

Other
   version                        Show version

Run 'manax help <command>' for detailed usage.
help.install:
Usage: manax install

Install the compatible kernel, GeoData, system-wise service and this user's login task.
If the kernel and all GeoData already exist, resource installation can be skipped; otherwise download from GitHub or provide a resource ZIP.
help.uninstall:
Usage: manax uninstall

Remove the system-wise service and program, and clean up login tasks
created by Manax. User configs are kept by default.
help.daemon:
Usage: manax daemon

Start the background service that manages the kernel process and privileged
network operations. Normally invoked automatically by the service manager.
